# ASCON LIVING Riverside

> ASCON LIVING Riverside is a holiday house (homestay, vacation rental) in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), Vietnam, rented as a whole to one party. It has 3 floors plus a rooftop, more than 250 m2, 3 bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, a full kitchen and self check-in. The house also has a river view from the rooftop, karaoke and an entertainment setup, all included.

Address: 389A Đường Trần Xuân Soạn, Tân Hưng, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Coordinates: 10.7516358, 106.7103995. Phone: +84 909 410 382. The website is available in 23 languages.

## Key facts

- Whole house, not shared with other guests: 3 floors plus rooftop, more than 250 m2
- 3 bedrooms, each with en-suite bathroom and air conditioning, plus a guest WC
- Master bedroom: 180x200 bed, balcony, 4K TV; bedrooms 2 and 3: 160x200 beds, smart TV
- Living room about 40 m2 with 75-inch 4K TV
- Rooftop about 56-60 m2 with BBQ, outdoor sofa, river and city skyline view
- Entertainment: karaoke, PS5 (PlayStation 5) with PlayStation Plus, gaming, 4K cinema system (Optoma 4K projector), Netflix
- Full kitchen with stove, oven, microwave, rice cooker and large fridge; washing machine, iron, safe
- Self check-in via keypad lock; separate key for the gate
- Cameras are installed outdoors only
- Airport transfer is offered with bookings
- House rule: loud music only until 21:30
- Host languages: German, English, Hindi, Punjabi, Urdu, Vietnamese
